name: look-l10-fields-r4-evac-z1
note: look-l10-l8-2 (QA batch 20: "The night fields are mostly empty dark green apart from the courier's lamp"): R4 military zone: a flood-lit evac point in the field (light tower, iso tents, generator, ambulance, sandbags), crop rows and a burning car. Look for: ground that reads as a place, warm pools off the route verge, nothing floating or sunk, no clipping, no flicker.
